craft_notes: Sthāyin: samaya code opened. Rows: love, aversion, reverence. Read aloud: vows.

lines: In master whole-souled, love; so in writ; in God; from their foes aversion;
as to the master, to master's son and the rest;
of lore-bound wrought, of fore-hallowed and the rest, beholding;
of womb-tie, for its honouring, not of self — thus deem.
l4.sanskrit_cite: gurau sarvātmanā bhaktiḥ tathā śāstre deve tatpratidvaṃdvini parāṅmukhatā guruvat guruputrādeḥ vidyāsambandhakṛtasya tatpūrvadīkṣitādeḥ saṃdarśanam yaunasambandhasya tadārādhanārtham na tu svata iti mantavyam
